print("Theory: Values on diagonals with MULTIPLE non-3 values stay; values on diagonals with only ONE value shift")

result = [[1]*15 for _ in range(7)]
result[3][3] = 3
result[4][2] = 3
result[5][2] = 3

positions = [(3, 0, 7), (4, 1, 7), (5, 1, 4)]

# Count non-3 values per diagonal
diag_count = {}
for r, c, v in positions:
    if v == 3:
        result[r][c] = 3
        continue
    diag = r - c
    diag_count[diag] = diag_count.get(diag, 0) + 1

print("Non-3 values per diagonal:")
for diag, cnt in diag_count.items():
    print(f"  Diagonal {diag}: {cnt} value(s)")

# Values on multi-value diagonals stay; single-value diagonals shift
for r, c, v in positions:
    if v == 3:
        result[r][c] = 3
        continue
    
    diag = r - c
    if diag_count[diag] > 1:
        # Multiple on diagonal, stay
        result[r][c] = v
    else:
        # Only one on diagonal, shift
        new_c = c - 1
        if new_c >= 0:
            result[r][new_c] = v

print("\nGrid (multi stays, single shifts):")
for r in range(7):
    print(result[r])

from json import dumps
print("\nSubmit:")
print(dumps({"action": "submit", "grid": result}))
